Wire junction node - connects a wire to another wire so a shared rail (GND, VCC) can be one wire with taps. Created by dropping a wire end onto an existing wire or with the node tool; hidden from the picker.

![Junction](../../../../assets/docs/parts/junction.png)

## Pins

| Pin   | Signals |
| ----- | ------- |
| **J** | —       |

## Use it

Add it from the [component picker](/docs/circuit-editor/placing-components/) — search for “Junction” (tags: junction, node, wire, net, solder).
Right-click it on the canvas for the in-editor datasheet, and check the
[examples gallery](https://velxio.dev/examples) for circuits that use it.
